title: OzTowns
description: Towns/LandClaim Plugin with raiding Features & Upkeep
body:
**THIS PLUGIN IS NO LONGER BEING UPDATED FEEL FREE TO EDIT THE SOURCE TO USE!**

### OzAnarchy Towns

Permission/Commands Found on the Github [Source Code](https://github.com/Brookylala/oztowns)

Personally use on my own server but figured others may like to give it a try.

A Minecraft Spigot/Paper towns plugin built for 1.21.11 servers with town creation, land claims, roles, economy, raids, and GUIs — ideal for anarchy or survival communities.

Bring structured town gameplay to your server while keeping the chaos of anarchy alive.
## 🌍 Features
- 🏘️ Town system: Create, rename, set mayor, leave or abandon towns
- 🌾 Chunk claiming with adjacency rules & restricted unclaiming
- 👥 Role system: mayor, officers & members with configurable permissions
- 💰 Town bank with deposits, withdrawals, upkeep billing & member allowances
- 🚩 Spawn system with delay, cooldown and automatic reminders
- ⚔️ Raiding mechanics: Lockpick a town’s Lodestone, survive and take rewards
- 📊 GUI menus for towns, bank and member management
- 📍 Visual feedback: chunk claim particles for own/enemy/wilderness territories
- 🔌 Optional integrations: PlaceholderAPI & DecentHolograms
- 💬 Optional /tm town chat command

## 💣 Raiding
- Raids begin by lockpicking a town spawn Lodestone
- Raiders must survive 60 seconds to succeed
- On success:
  - Town bank funds transfer to the attacker’s town bank (or to the attacker if not in a town)
  - The entire town (claims, members, data) is deleted

## 🔧 Requirements
- Java 21
- Spigot/Paper API 1.21.11
- Storage backend:
  - MySQL (when `storage.type: mysql`), or
  - SQLite (when `storage.type: sqlite`)
- Economy backend (pick one):
  - `ozanarchy-economy` plugin (when `economy-plugin: ozanarchy-economy`) (default), or
  - `Vault` plugin (when `economy-plugin: vault`) plus any Vault-compatible economy plugin
- Optional plugins:
  - `OminousChestLock` (enables raiding lockpick integration)
  - `PlaceholderAPI`
  - `DecentHolograms`
